description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) attached to planning permission 24/00693/CONR for the Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) attached to planning permission ref. 21/03786/CONR for the variation of Conditions 2 (Approved Drawings) and 11 (Accessible Units) attached to planning permission ref. 20/00064/FUL for the demolition of the existing building and erection of a block of flats comprising of 9 units with associated parking and landscaping, granted 23.04.2024, relating to the original permission 20/00064/FUL. The application seeks to regularise minor amendments to the external layout made during construction, as outlined below. 1. Main Building Entrance: The approved ramp has been replaced with a more direct approach incorporating a gentle gradient. This improves accessibility and privacy by avoiding pedestrian movement immediately past Flat 2's windows and private garden, while also increasing its private garden space. 2. Bin Store: The approved bin store location remains unchanged. Only its entrance and access arrangement have been revised to better screen the bins from Sanderstead Road and improve access for refuse collection. 3. Rear Garden Steps: The steps have been repositioned towards the side of the site to accommodate existing ground levels, creating a larger, more continuous communal garden area for residents. 4. Main Entrance Gate: An electronically automated entrance gate is proposed to control unauthorised vehicle access, including unwanted parking and caravans. The gate will open automatically for authorised vehicles, with sufficient waiting space provided within the site to prevent obstruction of the public highway.
